errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Не' sector is dark blue ('тъмно синьо'), but the color in the chart is clearly teal or cyan, not dark blue.

errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени по вертикална ос
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors are arranged along a vertical axis ('разположени по вертикална ос'). Pie charts do not have axes in this manner; they are circular representations of parts of a whole. This misrepresents the fundamental structure of the chart.
